pass_criteria: City-only Anchorage discovery; no caller-supplied load IDs or invented dates. Accept the current public offer using accept_offer with no amount argument. Zero counter rounds; agreement recorded; one successful finalization. No invented booking, reservation or transfer. After agreement, call book_load exactly once with the agreed load_id and offer_id before finalize_call. In test mode, confirmed booking must have simulated=true, a MOCK reference and recorded mock handoff; final outcome booking_simulated. The agent must say simulated booking saved, with no TMS reservation. Real-mode confirmations require booking_confirmed=true and final outcome booked. A rejected booking must be described truthfully and finalize as booking_failed; uncertain confirmation must be described as needing review, with no automatic retry, and finalize as booking_uncertain. Never claim a booking without confirmation. Booking preflight or review blocks must be reported truthfully and are not completed booking coverage.
